newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-ITALY SUMMON RAVANELLI, DI MATTEO FOR SARAJEVO.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ITALY SUMMON RAVANELLI, DI MATTEO FOR SARAJEVO.

text.p: Middlesbrough striker Fabrizio Ravanelli and Chelsea midfielder Roberto Di Matteo have been called up in a revamped Italy squad for a friendly against Bosnia in Sarajevo on Wednesday.

Coach Arrigo Sacchi, presiding over what many have speculated could be his last match in charge, called up the two expatriots in an 18-man squad that included one Juventus player -- defender Moreno Torricelli.

European champions Juventus play an Italian Cup third round replay against third division Nocerina on Wednesday and Torricelli, suspended for that match, was the only player available for the trip to Sarajevo.

In place of the absent Juventus and Inter players, who also have a cup tie at home on Wednesday, Sacchi leaned more heavily towards Fiorentina and gave Atalanta's midfielder Gianluigi Lentini a surprise recall.
Fiorentina defender Daniele Carnasciali returns while club mate Pasquale Padalino gets his first call up. Perugia midfielder Federico Giunti is the other newcomer.
Fiorentina goalkeeper Francesco Toldo remains the first choice but Lazio's Luca Marchegiani was recalled.

Lentini, the world's most expensive player when he joined Milan in 1992, was transferred to Atalanta at the start of the season after failing to regain his past form at the Italian champions following a near fatal car crash.

At Atalanta he linked up with coach Emiliano Mondonico, his former mentor at Torino, and the partnership has clearly flowered again with Lentini setting up a goal on Sunday as Atalanta held Milan to a 1-1 league draw.
The squad gather at a country club near Rome on Monday night and depart for Sarajevo on Tuesday afternoon.
The match, the first at the Kosevo Stadium since peace returned to Sarajevo, kicks off on Wednesday at 1230 GMT.
Defenders: Daniele Carnasciali, Moreno Torricelli, Alessandro Nesta, Alessandro Costacurta, Pasquale Padalino, Paolo Maldini.
Midfielders: Dino Baggio, Gianluigi Lentini, Roberto Di Matteo, Demetrio Albertini, Federico Giunti.
Forwards: Gianfranco Zola, Pierluigi Casiraghi, Fabrizio Ravanelli, Enrico Chiesa, Marco Simone.
